Title: Sanjay and the Family

Cast

1. Sanjay - 35 years, son
Look: white kurta-pyjama
2. Anita - 28 years, daughter
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Meenakshi - 57 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The office - desks, computers, a glass wall
3. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Sanjay stands in the living room. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Meenakshi: "Let's do something fun today."

[Sanjay waves at his sister on a video call.]

Sanjay: "One more time!"

[Sanjay takes a selfie with Mother.]

Meenakshi: "Well done!"

Scene 2: The office - Day

[Sanjay stands in the office. Meenakshi and Anita stand near him.]

Anita: "Let's begin."

[Sanjay sits down at his desk and starts typing.]

Meenakshi: "That's easy."

[Sanjay presents the chart and points at the screen.]

Meenakshi (laughing): "That's easy."

[Sanjay shakes hands with the new client.]

Sanjay: "And then?"

Scene 3: The terrace - Day

Anita: "So, here we are!"

[Anita hangs the wet clothes on the line.]

Meenakshi: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Sanjay ties a letter to the pigeon and lets it fly.]

Sanjay: "Yes, of course."

[Sanjay falls from the ladder and hurts his leg.]

Sanjay (laughing): "I really enjoyed today."
